physical_detail.r2_definition: Net slope in radians per useful OFDM-symbol duration between the first and last mid-sample. True slope uses integrated simulator Doppler. Wrong sign means the fitted and true slopes have opposite signs. Phase MAE removes one constant angle per burst-ray and uses wrapped mid-sample errors.
physical_detail.r3_definition: Each stage compares the same waveform fit immediately before and after the branch. The estimated rank-one projector is held fixed. A second projection uses the true normalized ULA steering vector after inference. RMS ratios pool squared cross-antenna residual magnitudes.
